recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7845 unless a future Pharmacy work-group decision creates a new MedicationStatement-specific v2 mapping policy distinct from generic Dosage datatype mappings.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the 2015 May DSTU QA cycle asking to blank the MedicationStatement dosage site v2 mapping to RXR-2 Administration Site because MedicationStatement is not a v2 medication transaction concept.
initial_application: The issue was applied during the DSTU QA process. Commit 5bb461af1063efe577bac2b8b17b6992be7560bf explicitly included tracker item 7845 and removed the historical MedicationStatement.dosageInstruction.site v2 mapping value RXR-2-Administration Site from the MedicationStatement spreadsheet source.
additional_context: MedicationStatement remains active in the current build. The old MedicationStatement.dosageInstruction.site element no longer exists after dosage refactoring; current MedicationStatement.dosage is typed as DosageDetails and the current resource-level v2 mappings include only MedicationStatement.subject to PID-3. The generic Dosage datatype still maps Dosage.site to RXR-2, but that is datatype-wide and not the MedicationStatement-specific mapping FHIR-7845 requested to remove. Zulip and Confluence searches found no contrary later discussion, and the current rendered build page has no RXR-2 or Administration Site hit for MedicationStatement mappings.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the authoritative current MedicationStatement source and rendered mapping surface already reflect the requested removal.
